		set_variable = { name = kehillah_commission_work_loc value = flag:work_memar_marqah }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = kehillah_commission_work value = flag:work_memar_marqah }
		trigger_event = kehillah_library.0002
	}
}

kehillah_lib_acquire_work_defter = {
	scope = character
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = {
		is_adult = yes
		is_imprisoned = no
		kehillah_lib_can_commission_trigger = yes
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = kehillah_lib_seek_held_tt
			var:kehillah_own_library ?= { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_defter } } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = kehillah_lib_seek_busy_tt
			var:kehillah_own_library ?= { NOT = { has_variable_list = kehillah_library_commission_work } }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = kehillah_lib_seek_unwritten_tt
			var:kehillah_own_library ?= {
				current_date >= 400.1.1
			}
		}
	}
	effect = {
		# The commission events check the cached list; rebuild it first.
		kehillah_library_refresh_acquisition_candidates_effect = yes
		set_variable = { name = kehillah_commission_work_loc value = flag:work_defter }
		save_scope_value_as = { name = kehillah_commission_work value = flag:work_defter }
		trigger_event = kehillah_library.0002
	}
}
